name: NGQA
description: A graph question answering benchmark for personalized nutritional health reasoning, leveraging real-world health and nutrition datasets. It evaluates models on user-specific dietary health questions with explanations, across multiple complexity levels and downstream tasks.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark for personalized nutritional health reasoning that is still emerging in the research community.
notes: First benchmark to combine graph QA with personalized nutritional reasoning; uses NHANES and FNDDS data.
